text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ is reading a fan letter
one day in
my office and smiles to
herself.

"The way your intellect shines in your
eyes
through your glasses is wonderful!"
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It feels strange to be praised for my
glasses. After
all, I only wear them for
the sake of correcting my
weak vision.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Still, your fans find them appealing.

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I can use how others see me to
create a
more favorable image of myself.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
These fan letters provide great insight
into how
others regard me and what they
expect from me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
As someone who's constantly in the
public eye, I
must do my best to retain
my fans' support.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'll have to take greater care in how I
present
myself and refine the attributes
that set me apart
from others.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
First and foremost, I'll start with the way
I clean
my glasses.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I can't help but notice the sense of pride
that
emanates from her as she adjusts
her glasses.
